📱 Customer Display — Hotspot + QR Pairing

    
ଏହି feature ଦ୍ୱାରା ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ mobile ରେ କେବଳ Invoice Amount ଓ Payment QR ଦେଖାଯିବ। Internet ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ; ଦୁଇଟି mobile ଏକେ Hotspot/Wi-Fi network ରେ ଥିବା ଦରକାର।

    
ପ୍ରଥମେ: Main mobile ରେ Hotspot ON କରନ୍ତୁ। Secondary mobile କୁ ସେହି Hotspot ରେ connect କରନ୍ତୁ। ଦୁଇଟି mobile ରେ ଏହି POS app ଖୋଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

    
⚪ Not connected • Choose Main Phone or Customer Phone

    

     
     
    

    
Pairing QR will appear here

    
Main phone: generate the first QR. Customer phone: scan it, then show the response QR back to the Main phone.

    
    

     
     
    

    

     
     
    

    
Pairing uses a direct WebRTC connection over the local hotspot. QR pairing is a two-way exchange: Main QR → Customer scan → Customer response QR → Main scan. The app cannot switch Android Hotspot ON automatically; please enable it in Android settings.
